what: Proposed ship_pr_with_transient_retry loses rc=0 envelope exhaustion semantics
scenario_or_breakage: merge-pr.sh and ci-wait.sh can emit transient failure envelopes while exiting 0; after three predicate-triggered retries the lifted helper returns _WTR_RC=0, so the proposed wrapper returns success instead of exit_transient_net
suggested_fix: Have with_transient_retry expose an exhausted-transient flag, or otherwise let ship_pr_with_transient_retry detect predicate exhaustion before any rc=0 return

what: Plan shows a bare return-style helper contract that breaks under set -e
scenario_or_breakage: Most target scripts use set -euo pipefail; if with_transient_retry returns nonzero as a simple command, the script exits before reading _WTR_RC and emitting its existing structured failure output
suggested_fix: Require each set -e callsite to invoke the helper in an if/set +e guard, then copy _WTR_RC and _WTR_OUT before restoring existing error handling

what: Wrapping git clone is scope creep and not an idempotent retry
scenario_or_breakage: The first failed clone can leave clone_dir populated; the retry then fails with destination exists instead of retrying the network operation
suggested_fix: Drop the git clone wrap from this minimum-change plan, or add explicit cleanup of clone_dir between retry attempts if clone retry is truly required
